<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>global.BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>Build Agent - Update Set Back Out (bypasses BackOutAPI for scoped app compatibility)</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[/**
 * Build Agent update set backout that bypasses SNC.BackOutAPI for scoped app compatibility.
 *
 * The standard BackOutAPI fails for scoped apps due to:
 *   1. SystemFieldPurgingChecker.isSystemName() uses session scope prefix instead of app prefix
 *   2. RecordPurger.isSystemMetadata() blocks purge for non-sys_app/sys_scope packages
 *   3. Business rule cascade failures on tables with M2M relationships
 *
 * This class uses GlideappUpdateVersion.revert() for existing records and direct
 * record deletion for new records, bypassing all three issues.
 *
 * Handles hierarchical update sets: when the target update set has children
 * (as created by the checkpoint system), all descendants are discovered and
 * processed in reverse order (deepest children first, then parent).
 *
 * Atomicity features:
 *   - Pre-backout manifest persisted to sys_properties for recoverability
 *   - Fail-fast mode (default): stops processing on first error
 *   - Guarded deletion: update set metadata preserved when errors occur
 *   - Baseline version fallback: checks sys_upgrade_history before purging
 *   - Superseded version detection: blocks revert of non-latest versions
 *   - Invalid field change detection: blocks reverts that would change field types
 *     or reduce field lengths when the field contains data
 *   - Data-loss guards: blocks purging tables that contain data
 *   - Progress reporting via optional GlideExecutionTracker
 */
class BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut {
    static TABLES = {
        UPDATE_SET: 'sys_update_set',
        UPDATE_VERSION: 'sys_update_version',
        UPDATE_XML: 'sys_update_xml',
        SYS_METADATA: 'sys_metadata'
    };

    static STATES = {
        CURRENT: 'current',
        PREVIOUS: 'previous',
        BACKED_OUT: 'backed_out'
    };

    static LOG_PREFIX = '[BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut]';

    static MANIFEST_PROPERTY_PREFIX = 'build_agent.backout.manifest.';

    constructor(updateSetId, options) {
        if (!updateSetId) {
            throw new Error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': updateSetId is required');
        }

        this._updateSetId = updateSetId;
        this._options = {
            dryRun: false,
            verbose: false,
            deleteUpdateSet: true,
            useWorkspaceSet: true,
            failFast: true,
            tracker: null
        };
        if (options) {
            for (var key in options) {
                if (options.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                    this._options[key] = options[key];
                }
            }
        }

        this._stats = {
            reverted: 0,
            purged: 0,
            skipped: 0,
            errors: 0,
            deduplicatedMarked: 0,
            errorDetails: []
        };
        this._originalUpdateSetId = null;
        this._workspaceUpdateSetId = null;
        this._updateSetHierarchy = [updateSetId];
        this._manifest = null;
    }

    /**
     * Main orchestration: validate, discover hierarchy, build manifest, process, cleanup.
     * Processes child update sets before the parent (reverse hierarchy order).
     * @returns {Object} stats - { reverted, purged, skipped, errors, deduplicatedMarked, errorDetails }
     */
    backOut() {
        this._log('Starting backout for update set: ' + this._updateSetId);
        this._reportProgress('Starting backout for update set: ' + this._updateSetId);

        this._validateUpdateSet();

        // Discover hierarchy: children first, root last
        this._updateSetHierarchy = this._getUpdateSetHierarchy(this._updateSetId);
        this._log('Update set hierarchy (' + this._updateSetHierarchy.length + ' update sets): ' +
            this._updateSetHierarchy.join(', '));

        // Build and persist manifest before any mutations
        this._manifest = this._buildManifest();
        this._persistManifest(this._manifest);
        this._reportProgress('Built manifest with ' + this._manifest.totalVersions + ' operations');

        // Pre-validation: scan the manifest for blocking issues across ALL
        // update sets in the hierarchy before any mutations begin. This prevents
        // partial backouts where early update sets succeed but a later one has
        // a superseded or unsafe version, leaving the app in an inconsistent state.
        var blockedOps = [];
        for (var m = 0; m < this._manifest.operations.length; m++) {
            var op = this._manifest.operations[m];
            if (op.action === 'blocked_superseded' || op.action === 'blocked_unsafe' || op.action === 'blocked_data_loss') {
                blockedOps.push(op);
            }
        }
        if (blockedOps.length > 0) {
            for (var b = 0; b < blockedOps.length; b++) {
                var blockMsg = 'Pre-validation: ' + blockedOps[b].name + ' — ' +
                    (blockedOps[b].reason || blockedOps[b].action);
                gs.error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': ' + blockMsg);
                this._stats.errors++;
                this._stats.errorDetails.push(blockMsg);
            }
            this._log('Pre-validation failed: ' + blockedOps.length +
                ' blocking issue(s) found across all update sets. No mutations performed.');
            this._reportProgress('Pre-validation failed: ' + blockedOps.length + ' blocking issue(s)');
            return this._stats;
        }

        if (this._options.useWorkspaceSet) {
            this._switchToWorkspaceUpdateSet();
        }

        // NOTE: Ideally we would set UpdateController.setLoading(true) here so
        // that business rules checking isLoading() skip execution during our
        // reverts/deletes. However, Packages.com.glide.update is blocked by
        // the script security manager. Instead we rely on:
        //   1. Workspace update set isolation (changes tracked there, then deleted)
        //   2. setWorkflow(false) on version state updates and delete fallbacks

        // Shared across all update sets so cross-update-set dedup works correctly
        var processedNames = {};

        try {
            for (var h = 0; h < this._updateSetHierarchy.length; h++) {
                var currentUpdateSetId = this._updateSetHierarchy[h];
                this._log('Processing update set ' + (h + 1) + '/' +
                    this._updateSetHierarchy.length + ': ' + currentUpdateSetId);
                this._reportProgress('Processing update set ' + (h + 1) + '/' +
                    this._updateSetHierarchy.length);

                var orderedVersions = this._getOrderedVersions(currentUpdateSetId);
                this._logVerbose('Found ' + orderedVersions.length + ' versions in update set ' + currentUpdateSetId);

                for (var i = 0; i < orderedVersions.length; i++) {
                    // Fail-fast: stop on first error
                    if (this._options.failFast && this._stats.errors > 0) {
                        this._log('Fail-fast: stopping after ' + this._stats.errors + ' error(s)');
                        break;
                    }

                    var versionGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
                    if (!versionGr.get(orderedVersions[i])) {
                        this._logVerbose('Version not found, skipping: ' + orderedVersions[i]);
                        this._stats.skipped++;
                        continue;
                    }
                    this._processVersion(versionGr, processedNames);
                }

                // Fail-fast: stop processing remaining update sets
                if (this._options.failFast && this._stats.errors > 0) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            // Guard deletion: skip when errors occurred to preserve recovery info
            if (this._stats.errors > 0) {
                this._log('Skipping update set deletion due to ' + this._stats.errors +
                    ' error(s). Update set metadata preserved for recovery.');
                this._reportProgress('Backout completed with errors. Update set preserved.');
            } else if (this._options.deleteUpdateSet) {
                // Delete in same order (children first) to avoid FK issues
                for (var d = 0; d < this._updateSetHierarchy.length; d++) {
                    this._deleteUpdateXmlEntries(this._updateSetHierarchy[d]);
                    this._deleteUpdateSet(this._updateSetHierarchy[d]);
                }
            }

            // Manifest cleanup: clear on success, preserve on failure
            if (this._stats.errors === 0) {
                this._clearManifest();
            } else {
                this._log('Manifest preserved for recovery: ' +
                    BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.MANIFEST_PROPERTY_PREFIX + this._updateSetId);
            }

            this._log('Backout complete. Stats: reverted=' + this._stats.reverted +
                ', purged=' + this._stats.purged +
                ', skipped=' + this._stats.skipped +
                ', errors=' + this._stats.errors +
                ', deduplicatedMarked=' + this._stats.deduplicatedMarked);
            this._reportProgress('Backout complete: ' + this._stats.reverted + ' reverted, ' +
                this._stats.purged + ' purged, ' + this._stats.errors + ' errors');

            return this._stats;
        } finally {
            if (this._options.useWorkspaceSet) {
                this._restoreOriginalUpdateSet();
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Report progress to the optional execution tracker.
     * No-op when tracker is null.
     * @param {string} message - progress message
     */
    _reportProgress(message) {
        if (this._options.tracker) {
            this._options.tracker.updateDetailMessage(message);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Classify a version as dedup, revert, or purge.
     * Shared by _buildManifest (planning) and _processVersion (execution) to
     * ensure the manifest always matches actual behavior.
     * @param {string} name - version name
     * @param {string} recordedAt - sys_recorded_at of the version
     * @param {Object} processedNames - map of already-processed version names
     * @returns {Object} { action: 'dedup'|'revert'|'purge', previousVersion: {sysId,payload}|null }
     */
    _classifyVersion(name, recordedAt, processedNames) {
        if (processedNames[name]) {
            return { action: 'dedup', previousVersion: null };
        }

        var previousVersion = this._findPreviousVersion(name, recordedAt);
        if (!previousVersion) {
            previousVersion = this._findBaselineVersion(name);
        }

        if (previousVersion) {
            return { action: 'revert', previousVersion: previousVersion };
        }
        return { action: 'purge', previousVersion: null };
    }

    /**
     * Build a pre-backout manifest describing all planned operations.
     * This is a read-only planning phase — no mutations occur.
     * Flags invalid field changes and superseded versions so dry runs
     * reveal blocking issues before any mutations.
     * @returns {Object} manifest with updateSetId, hierarchy, createdAt, totalVersions, operations[]
     */
    _buildManifest() {
        var operations = [];
        var processedNames = {};

        for (var h = 0; h < this._updateSetHierarchy.length; h++) {
            var currentUpdateSetId = this._updateSetHierarchy[h];
            var orderedVersions = this._getOrderedVersions(currentUpdateSetId);

            for (var i = 0; i < orderedVersions.length; i++) {
                var versionGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
                if (!versionGr.get(orderedVersions[i])) {
                    continue;
                }

                var versionState = versionGr.getValue('state');
                if (versionState === BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.STATES.BACKED_OUT) {
                    continue;
                }

                var name = versionGr.getValue('name');
                var recordedAt = versionGr.getValue('sys_recorded_at');
                var classification = this._classifyVersion(
                    name,
                    recordedAt,
                    processedNames
                );

                if (classification.action !== 'dedup') {
                    processedNames[name] = true;
                }

                // Determine the effective action after safety checks
                var effectiveAction = classification.action;
                var reason = null;

                if (classification.action !== 'dedup') {
                    // Superseded check takes priority
                    if (this._isSuperseded(name, recordedAt)) {
                        effectiveAction = 'blocked_superseded';
                        reason = 'Superseded by a newer version from another update set';
                    }
                    // Invalid field change check (only for reverts)
                    else if (classification.action === 'revert' && classification.previousVersion) {
                        var fieldCheck = this._isInvalidFieldChange(name, classification.previousVersion.payload);
                        if (fieldCheck.isInvalid) {
                            effectiveAction = 'blocked_unsafe';
                            reason = fieldCheck.reason;
                        }
                    }
                    // Table data-loss check (only for purges of sys_db_object records)
                    else if (classification.action === 'purge') {
                        var recordInfo = this._extractRecordInfo(name);
                        if (recordInfo && recordInfo.table === 'sys_db_object') {
                            var objGr = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object');
                            if (objGr.get(recordInfo.sysId)) {
                                var tableCheck = this._isTablePurgeWithData(objGr.getValue('name'));
                                if (tableCheck.hasData) {
                                    effectiveAction = 'blocked_data_loss';
                                    reason = tableCheck.reason;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                operations.push({
                    versionId: orderedVersions[i],
                    name: name,
                    action: effectiveAction,
                    reason: reason,
                    previousVersionId: classification.previousVersion ? classification.previousVersion.sysId : null,
                    updateSetId: currentUpdateSetId
                });
            }
        }

        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        return {
            updateSetId: this._updateSetId,
            hierarchy: this._updateSetHierarchy,
            createdAt: now.getDisplayValue(),
            totalVersions: operations.length,
            operations: operations
        };
    }

    /**
     * Persist the manifest to a sys_property for recovery.
     * If the manifest exceeds 60KB, strips verbose fields to fit.
     * @param {Object} manifest - the manifest to persist
     */
    _persistManifest(manifest) {
        var propertyName = BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.MANIFEST_PROPERTY_PREFIX + this._updateSetId;
        var json = JSON.stringify(manifest);

        // Size guard: sys_properties has practical limits
        if (json.length > 60000) {
            this._log('Manifest exceeds 60KB (' + json.length + ' chars). Stripping verbose fields.');
            var trimmed = {
                updateSetId: manifest.updateSetId,
                hierarchy: manifest.hierarchy,
                createdAt: manifest.createdAt,
                totalVersions: manifest.totalVersions,
                operations: []
            };
            for (var i = 0; i < manifest.operations.length; i++) {
                trimmed.operations.push({
                    versionId: manifest.operations[i].versionId,
                    action: manifest.operations[i].action
                });
            }
            json = JSON.stringify(trimmed);
        }

        gs.setProperty(propertyName, json);
        this._logVerbose('Persisted manifest to property: ' + propertyName);
    }

    /**
     * Delete the manifest property record after successful backout.
     */
    _clearManifest() {
        var propertyName = BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.MANIFEST_PROPERTY_PREFIX + this._updateSetId;
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_properties');
        gr.addQuery('name', propertyName);
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            gr.deleteRecord();
            this._logVerbose('Deleted manifest property record: ' + propertyName);
        } else {
            this._logVerbose('Manifest property record not found (already deleted): ' + propertyName);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Discover the full hierarchy of update sets rooted at the given ID.
     * Uses BFS to find all descendants via the parent field.
     * Returns them in reverse order: deepest children first, root last.
     * This ensures child update set changes are backed out before parent changes.
     * @param {string} rootUpdateSetId - the root update set sys_id
     * @returns {string[]} ordered update set sys_ids (children first, root last)
     */
    _getUpdateSetHierarchy(rootUpdateSetId) {
        // BFS to collect all descendants in breadth-first order
        var queue = [rootUpdateSetId];
        var ordered = [rootUpdateSetId];
        var visited = {};
        visited[rootUpdateSetId] = true;

        while (queue.length > 0) {
            var currentId = queue.shift();

            var childGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_SET);
            childGr.addQuery('parent', currentId);
            childGr.query();

            while (childGr.next()) {
                var childId = childGr.getUniqueValue();
                if (!visited[childId]) {
                    visited[childId] = true;
                    ordered.push(childId);
                    queue.push(childId);
                }
            }
        }

        // Reverse: deepest children first, root last
        ordered.reverse();
        return ordered;
    }

    /**
     * Confirm update set exists and is in complete state.
     */
    _validateUpdateSet() {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_SET);
        if (!gr.get(this._updateSetId)) {
            throw new Error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': Update set not found: ' + this._updateSetId);
        }

        var state = gr.getValue('state');
        if (state !== 'complete') {
            throw new Error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': Update set must be complete. Current state: ' + state);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Query versions in 7 dependency-safe groups ordered for safe reversal.
     * Within each group: name ASC, sys_recorded_at ASC.
     * Retrieves all versions from the update set in any state except backed_out.
     * Non-current versions (e.g. previous) are included so that _buildManifest
     * can detect superseded entries during pre-validation.
     * @param {string} updateSetId - the update set to query versions for
     * @returns {string[]} ordered array of sys_update_version sys_ids
     */
    _getOrderedVersions(updateSetId) {
        var allVersionSysIds = [];
        var allProcessedIds = {};
        var self = this;

        function queryGroup(encodedQueryPart, label) {
            var gr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
            gr.addQuery('source', updateSetId);
            gr.addQuery('state', '!=', BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.STATES.BACKED_OUT);
            if (encodedQueryPart) {
                gr.addEncodedQuery(encodedQueryPart);
            }
            gr.orderBy('name');
            gr.orderBy('sys_recorded_at');
            gr.query();

            var ids = [];
            while (gr.next()) {
                var id = gr.getUniqueValue();
                if (!allProcessedIds[id]) {
                    ids.push(id);
                    allProcessedIds[id] = true;
                }
            }
            self._logVerbose('Group "' + label + '": ' + ids.length + ' versions');
            return ids;
        }

        // Group 1: UI Views
        allVersionSysIds = allVersionSysIds.concat(
            queryGroup('nameSTARTSWITHsys_ui_view_', 'UI Views')
        );

        // Group 2: Documentation
        allVersionSysIds = allVersionSysIds.concat(
            queryGroup('nameSTARTSWITHsys_documentation_', 'Documentation')
        );

        // Groups 3 & 4: Dictionary (split collections vs fields in JS)
        var dictGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
        dictGr.addQuery('source', updateSetId);
        dictGr.addQuery('state', '!=', BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.STATES.BACKED_OUT);
        dictGr.addEncodedQuery('nameSTARTSWITHsys_dictionary_^nameNOT LIKEsys_dictionary_override');
        dictGr.orderBy('name');
        dictGr.orderBy('sys_recorded_at');
        dictGr.query();

        var dictCollections = [];
        var dictFields = [];
        while (dictGr.next()) {
            var dictId = dictGr.getUniqueValue();
            if (allProcessedIds[dictId]) {
                continue;
            }
            allProcessedIds[dictId] = true;

            var dictName = dictGr.getValue('name');
            if (dictName.match(/_null$/)) {
                dictCollections.push(dictId);
            } else {
                dictFields.push(dictId);
            }
        }
        this._logVerbose('Group "Dictionary collections": ' + dictCollections.length + ' versions');
        this._logVerbose('Group "Dictionary fields": ' + dictFields.length + ' versions');
        allVersionSysIds = allVersionSysIds.concat(dictCollections);
        allVersionSysIds = allVersionSysIds.concat(dictFields);

        // Group 5: Table records
        allVersionSysIds = allVersionSysIds.concat(
            queryGroup('nameSTARTSWITHsys_db_object_', 'Table records')
        );

        // Group 6: App records
        allVersionSysIds = allVersionSysIds.concat(
            queryGroup('nameSTARTSWITHsys_app_', 'App records')
        );

        // Group 7: Everything else
        var processedIdList = Object.keys(allProcessedIds);

        if (processedIdList.length > 0) {
            var catchAllGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
            catchAllGr.addQuery('source', updateSetId);
            catchAllGr.addQuery('state', '!=', BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.STATES.BACKED_OUT);
            catchAllGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'NOT IN', processedIdList.join(','));
            catchAllGr.orderBy('name');
            catchAllGr.orderBy('sys_recorded_at');
            catchAllGr.query();

            var catchAllIds = [];
            while (catchAllGr.next()) {
                catchAllIds.push(catchAllGr.getUniqueValue());
            }
            this._logVerbose('Group "Everything else": ' + catchAllIds.length + ' versions');
            allVersionSysIds = allVersionSysIds.concat(catchAllIds);
        } else {
            // No versions matched prior groups - query all
            allVersionSysIds = allVersionSysIds.concat(
                queryGroup('', 'Everything (no prior groups)')
            );
        }

        return allVersionSysIds;
    }

    /**
     * Process a single version: decide revert vs purge, execute, mark backed out.
     * Uses errorsBefore pattern to avoid double-counting errors from _deleteRecord.
     * @param {GlideRecord} versionGr - sys_update_version record
     * @param {Object} processedNames - map of already-processed version names
     */
    _processVersion(versionGr, processedNames) {
        var versionState = versionGr.getValue('state');

        // Idempotency: skip already backed-out versions
        if (versionState === BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.STATES.BACKED_OUT) {
            this._logVerbose('Skipping already backed-out version: ' + versionGr.getUniqueValue());
            this._stats.skipped++;
            return;
        }

        var name = versionGr.getValue('name');
        var recordedAt = versionGr.getValue('sys_recorded_at');
        var classification = this._classifyVersion(
            name,
            recordedAt,
            processedNames
        );

        // Deduplication: oldest version per name gets the actual revert
        if (classification.action === 'dedup') {
            if (!this._options.dryRun) {
                this._markVersionBackedOut(versionGr);
            }
            this._stats.deduplicatedMarked++;
            this._logVerbose('Dedup: marked version ' + versionGr.getUniqueValue() + ' for name: ' + name);
            return;
        }

        processedNames[name] = true;

        try {
            var errorsBefore = this._stats.errors;

            if (classification.action === 'revert') {
                if (!this._options.dryRun) {
                    var revertOk = this._revertVersion(classification.previousVersion.sysId, versionGr);
                    if (!revertOk) {
                        var revertErrMsg = 'Revert returned false for version ' +
                            versionGr.getUniqueValue() + ' (name: ' + name + ')';
                        gs.error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': ' + revertErrMsg);
                        this._stats.errors++;
                        this._stats.errorDetails.push(revertErrMsg);
                    }
                }
                if (this._stats.errors === errorsBefore) {
                    this._stats.reverted++;
                    this._logVerbose('Reverted: ' + name);
                }
            } else {
                if (!this._options.dryRun) {
                    this._purgeNewRecord(name, versionGr.getValue('payload'));
                }
                if (this._stats.errors === errorsBefore) {
                    this._stats.purged++;
                    this._logVerbose('Purged: ' + name);
                }
            }

            // Only mark backed out if no new errors occurred
            if (!this._options.dryRun && this._stats.errors === errorsBefore) {
                this._markVersionBackedOut(versionGr);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            var errorMsg = 'Error processing version ' +
                versionGr.getUniqueValue() + ' (name: ' + name + '): ' + e.message;
            gs.error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': ' + errorMsg);
            this._stats.errors++;
            this._stats.errorDetails.push(errorMsg);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Find the previous version of a record from before this update set hierarchy.
     * Excludes all update sets in the hierarchy (not just the root) to avoid
     * finding versions from sibling/child update sets.
     * @param {string} name - version name (table_sysId format)
     * @param {string} beforeTimestamp - sys_recorded_at of the current version
     * @returns {Object|null} { sysId, payload } or null if record is new
     */
    _findPreviousVersion(name, beforeTimestamp) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
        gr.addQuery('name', name);
        gr.addQuery('state', 'previous');
        gr.addQuery('source', 'NOT IN', this._updateSetHierarchy.join(','));
        gr.addQuery('sys_recorded_at', '<', beforeTimestamp);
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_recorded_at');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();

        if (gr.next()) {
            return {
                sysId: gr.getUniqueValue(),
                payload: gr.getValue('payload')
            };
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Find a baseline version from plugin/system upgrades (sys_upgrade_history).
     * This is the fallback when _findPreviousVersion returns null — the record
     * may have been delivered by a plugin and modified by the app. Reverting to
     * the baseline preserves the plugin record instead of purging it.
     * @param {string} name - version name (table_sysId format)
     * @returns {Object|null} { sysId, payload } or null if no baseline exists
     */
    _findBaselineVersion(name) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
        gr.addQuery('name', name);
        gr.addQuery('state', 'previous');
        gr.addQuery('source_table', 'sys_upgrade_history');
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_recorded_at');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();

        if (gr.next()) {
            return {
                sysId: gr.getUniqueValue(),
                payload: gr.getValue('payload')
            };
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Check if a version has been superseded by a later version from
     * outside this update set hierarchy. Query criteria:
     *   - Same name
     *   - State is current or previous (not just current)
     *   - Source is outside the hierarchy being backed out
     *   - Recorded at the same time or later than the version being checked
     *   - Not itself a reverted version
     *
     * @param {string} name - version name
     * @param {string} recordedAt - sys_recorded_at of the version being backed out
     * @returns {boolean} true if a later version exists outside hierarchy
     */
    _isSuperseded(name, recordedAt) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
        gr.addQuery('name', name);
        gr.addEncodedQuery('stateINcurrent,previous');
        gr.addQuery('source', 'NOT IN', this._updateSetHierarchy.join(','));
        gr.addQuery('sys_recorded_at', '>=', recordedAt);
        gr.addNullQuery('reverted_from');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();

        if (gr.next()) {
            this._logVerbose('Superseded: ' + name + ' has a later version (state=' +
                gr.getValue('state') + ') from source ' + gr.getValue('source') +
                ' (recorded at ' + gr.getValue('sys_recorded_at') + ')');
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Check if reverting a sys_dictionary version would cause data loss.
     * Guards against unsafe schema mutations:
     *   - Only applies to sys_dictionary versions being reverted (not purged)
     *   - Detects field type changes that would alter the storage format
     *   - Detects field length reductions that would truncate existing data
     *   - Only flags when the field actually contains data
     *
     * @param {string} name - version name (e.g., "sys_dictionary_x_app_table_field")
     * @param {string} targetPayload - XML payload of the version we'd revert TO
     * @returns {Object} { isInvalid: boolean, reason: string }
     */
    _isInvalidFieldChange(name, targetPayload) {
        var SAFE = { isInvalid: false, reason: '' };

        // Only check sys_dictionary versions
        if (!name || name.indexOf('sys_dictionary_') !== 0) {
            return SAFE;
        }

        // Must have a target payload to compare against
        if (!targetPayload) {
            return SAFE;
        }

        var targetDoc = new XMLDocument2();
        targetDoc.parseXML(targetPayload);

        // Check if the target action is a delete — deletion is always safe
        var actionAttr = targetDoc.getNodeText('//sys_dictionary/@action');
        if (actionAttr === 'DELETE' || actionAttr === 'delete' ||
            actionAttr === 'DELETE_MULTIPLE' || actionAttr === 'delete_multiple') {
            return SAFE;
        }

        // Extract element name and table name from target payload
        var targetElement = targetDoc.getNodeText('//element');
        var targetTable = targetDoc.getNodeText('//name');

        if (!targetElement || !targetTable) {
            this._logVerbose('InvalidFieldChange: Could not extract element/table from payload for ' + name);
            return SAFE;
        }

        // Check if the table and field exist in the live schema
        if (!GlideTableDescriptor.isValid(targetTable)) {
            return SAFE;
        }
        if (!GlideTableDescriptor.fieldExists(targetTable, targetElement)) {
            return SAFE;
        }

        // Check if the field currently exists in sys_dictionary (live metadata)
        var dictGr = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        dictGr.addQuery('name', targetTable);
        dictGr.addQuery('element', targetElement);
        dictGr.setLimit(1);
        dictGr.query();

        if (!dictGr.next()) {
            return SAFE;
        }

        // Check if the field has data before flagging type/length changes
        try {
            var agg = new GlideAggregate(targetTable);
            agg.addNotNullQuery(targetElement);
            agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
            agg.query();
            var hasData = false;
            if (agg.next()) {
                hasData = parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) > 0;
            }

            if (!hasData) {
                return SAFE;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            // If we can't verify the field is empty, block the revert. An
            // automated agent has no human to review skipped versions, so
            // the safe default is to assume data exists.
            return {
                isInvalid: true,
                reason: 'Field ' + targetTable + '.' + targetElement +
                    ' data check failed (' + e.message +
                    '). Blocking revert because data presence could not be confirmed.'
            };
        }

        // Compare field type: current live type vs. target payload type
        var currentType = dictGr.getValue('internal_type');
        var targetType = targetDoc.getNodeText('//internal_type');

        if (targetType && currentType && targetType !== currentType) {
            return {
                isInvalid: true,
                reason: 'Field ' + targetTable + '.' + targetElement +
                    ' type change (' + currentType + ' -> ' + targetType +
                    ') would be applied by revert, but field contains data. ' +
                    'Blocking revert to prevent data loss.'
            };
        }

        // Compare field length: check if target is shorter than current
        var currentLength = parseInt(dictGr.getValue('max_length'), 10);
        var targetLengthStr = targetDoc.getNodeText('//max_length');

        if (targetLengthStr) {
            var targetLength = parseInt(targetLengthStr, 10);

            if (!isNaN(targetLength) && targetLength >= 0 &&
                !isNaN(currentLength) && currentLength >= 0 &&
                targetLength < currentLength) {
                return {
                    isInvalid: true,
                    reason: 'Field ' + targetTable + '.' + targetElement +
                        ' length reduction (' + currentLength + ' -> ' + targetLength +
                        ') would be applied by revert, but field contains data. ' +
                        'Blocking revert to prevent data loss.'
                };
            }
        }

        return SAFE;
    }

    /**
     * Check if a table contains data rows. Used to block purges that would
     * drop tables with existing data.
     *
     * @param {string} tableName - the table name to check
     * @returns {Object} { hasData: boolean, reason: string }
     */
    _isTablePurgeWithData(tableName) {
        var SAFE = { hasData: false, reason: '' };

        if (!tableName) {
            return SAFE;
        }

        try {
            var dataGr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            dataGr.setLimit(1);
            dataGr.query();
            if (dataGr.next()) {
                return {
                    hasData: true,
                    reason: 'Table ' + tableName +
                        ' contains data. Blocking purge to prevent data loss.'
                };
            }
        } catch (e) {
            // Can't confirm table is empty — block to be safe
            return {
                hasData: true,
                reason: 'Table ' + tableName +
                    ' data check failed (' + e.message +
                    '). Blocking purge because data presence could not be confirmed.'
            };
        }

        return SAFE;
    }

    /**
     * Revert a record to its previous version.
     * Primary: GlideappUpdateVersion().revert(versionSysId) — no-arg constructor,
     *   revert() takes the sys_id of the sys_update_version record.
     * Fallback: GlideUpdateManager2.loadXML() with previous version's payload.
     *
     * @param {string} previousVersionId - sys_id of previous sys_update_version record
     * @param {GlideRecord} currentVersionGr - current version record (used for logging)
     * @returns {boolean} true if revert succeeded, false if it silently failed
     */
    _revertVersion(previousVersionId, currentVersionGr) {
        var name = currentVersionGr.getValue('name');

        // Primary approach: GlideappUpdateVersion (no-arg constructor)
        try {
            var updateVersion = new GlideappUpdateVersion();
            var result = updateVersion.revert(previousVersionId);
            if (result === false) {
                this._log('GlideappUpdateVersion.revert() returned false for ' + name +
                    '. Falling back to GlideUpdateManager2.loadXML()');
            } else {
                return true;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            this._log('GlideappUpdateVersion.revert() failed for ' + name +
                ': ' + e.message + '. Falling back to GlideUpdateManager2.loadXML()');
        }

        // Fallback: load previous version's payload directly
        var previousGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
        if (!previousGr.get(previousVersionId)) {
            throw new Error('Previous version record not found: ' + previousVersionId);
        }

        var payload = previousGr.getValue('payload');
        if (!payload) {
            throw new Error('Previous version has no payload: ' + previousVersionId);
        }

        var updateManager = new GlideUpdateManager2();
        updateManager.loadXML(payload);

        // Verify the revert applied by re-querying the version record.
        // If loadXML succeeded, the platform marks the previous version as
        // 'current'. We check this instead of gs.getLastErrorMessage() which
        // is a global singleton and unreliable (prior errors or business rule
        // side-effects can produce false positives).
        var verifyGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_VERSION);
        if (verifyGr.get(previousVersionId)) {
            var newState = verifyGr.getValue('state');
            if (newState === BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.STATES.CURRENT) {
                return true;
            }
            this._log('loadXML() did not promote previous version to current for ' +
                name + '. State is: ' + newState);
            return false;
        }

        // If we can't re-query the version, assume success — loadXML didn't throw
        this._log('Could not re-query previous version ' + previousVersionId +
            ' after loadXML for ' + name + '. Assuming success.');
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Purge a record that was new in this update set (no prior version exists).
     * Always deletes from the concrete table (not sys_metadata) so that
     * table-specific business rules fire — e.g., sys_db_object rules that
     * drop physical database tables, sys_dictionary rules that drop columns.
     *
     * Three resolution paths:
     *   Standard:  "table_name_<32-hex-sysid>" — delete directly.
     *   Composite: parsed table is an artificial wrapper (e.g. sys_ui_form_sections)
     *              that carries multiple inner records — delegate to _purgeCompositePayload.
     *   Dictionary: "sys_dictionary_<table>_<element>" — sys_metadata.sys_update_name lookup.
     *
     * @param {string} name - version name
     * @param {string} [payload] - update XML payload; required for composite wrapper records
     * @returns {boolean} true if purge succeeded, false if deletion failed
     */
    _purgeNewRecord(name, payload) {
        var recordInfo = this._extractRecordInfo(name);

        if (recordInfo) {
            if (recordInfo.table === 'sys_db_object') {
                return this._purgeTable(recordInfo.sysId, name);
            }
            if (!GlideTableDescriptor.isValid(recordInfo.table)) {
                return this._purgeCompositePayload(name, payload);
            }
            return this._deleteRecord(recordInfo.table, recordInfo.sysId, name);
        }

        // Fallback for non-standard version names (e.g. sys_dictionary_<table>_<element>).
        // Look up the actual record via sys_metadata.sys_update_name to get the
        // concrete table and sys_id.
        var metaGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.SYS_METADATA);
        metaGr.addQuery('sys_update_name', name);
        metaGr.setLimit(1);
        metaGr.query();

        if (metaGr.next()) {
            var concreteTable = metaGr.getValue('sys_class_name');
            var sysId = metaGr.getUniqueValue();
            this._logVerbose('Resolved via sys_metadata lookup: ' + name +
                ' -> ' + concreteTable + '/' + sysId);
            if (concreteTable === 'sys_db_object') {
                return this._purgeTable(sysId, name);
            } else {
                return this._deleteRecord(concreteTable, sysId, name);
            }
        } else {
            this._logVerbose('Record not found in sys_metadata for: ' + name +
                '. May already be deleted.');
            return true;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Purge a table (sys_db_object) record and its dependencies.
     *
     * When a table is created, the platform auto-generates records that
     * don't have sys_update_version entries and can block sys_db_object deletion:
     *   - sys_dictionary: system columns (sys_id, sys_created_on, etc.)
     *
     * Note: ua_table_licensing_config entries are intentionally NOT removed.
     * Subscription licensing records are managed by the platform and should
     * not be deleted during backout.
     *
     * Blocks deletion when the table contains data rows.
     * Cleans up dictionary dependencies first, then deletes the sys_db_object
     * record which triggers the physical table drop.
     *
     * @param {string} sysId - sys_id of the sys_db_object record
     * @param {string} name - version name for logging
     * @returns {boolean} true if purge succeeded, false if deletion failed
     */
    _purgeTable(sysId, name) {
        var objGr = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object');
        if (!objGr.get(sysId)) {
            this._logVerbose('Table record not found (may already be deleted): ' + sysId);
            return true;
        }
        var tableName = objGr.getValue('name');

        // Data-loss guard (defensive): pre-validation in _buildManifest blocks
        // data-loss purges before execution starts, so this should not match.
        // Retained as a safety net in case execution-time state diverges.
        var tableCheck = this._isTablePurgeWithData(tableName);
        if (tableCheck.hasData) {
            gs.error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': ' + tableCheck.reason);
            this._stats.errors++;
            this._stats.errorDetails.push(tableCheck.reason);
            return false;
        }

        // Remove all sys_dictionary entries for this table.
        // This includes both version-tracked entries (already handled but
        // harmless to re-delete) and system-generated entries (no version
        // tracking, would otherwise block the sys_db_object delete).
        var dictGr = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
        dictGr.addQuery('name', tableName);
        dictGr.query();
        this._logVerbose('Removing dictionary entries for table: ' + tableName);
        dictGr.deleteMultiple();

        // Now delete the sys_db_object record — should trigger physical table drop
        return this._deleteRecord('sys_db_object', sysId, name);
    }

    /**
     * Purge inner records carried by a composite wrapper payload. Inner records are
     * matched by the `action` attribute (which wrappers don't carry) and each inner
     * record's tag name + <sys_id> child give the real table and id.
     *
     * @param {string} name - version name (wrapper-style, e.g. sys_ui_form_sections_<id>)
     * @param {string} payload - update XML payload
     * @returns {boolean} true on success, false if payload missing or unparseable
     */
    _purgeCompositePayload(name, payload) {
        if (!payload) {
            var missingMsg = 'Composite wrapper record has no payload; cannot determine inner records to purge: ' + name;
            gs.error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': ' + missingMsg);
            this._stats.errors++;
            this._stats.errorDetails.push(missingMsg);
            return false;
        }

        var xmlDoc = new XMLDocument2();
        if (!xmlDoc.parseXML(payload)) {
            var parseErrMsg = 'Composite payload XML failed to parse: ' + name;
            gs.error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': ' + parseErrMsg);
            this._stats.errors++;
            this._stats.errorDetails.push(parseErrMsg);
            return false;
        }

        var node = xmlDoc.getFirstNode('//*[@action]');
        var attempted = 0;
        var succeeded = 0;
        // Attempt every inner child even if a sibling fails: composites are one logical
        // unit. fail-fast still halts at the next version via _processVersion.
        while (node) {
            var tableName = node.getNodeName();
            // Guard against a future wrapper variant carrying its own `action` attribute.
            if (!GlideTableDescriptor.isValid(tableName)) {
                this._logVerbose('Composite skip: not a real table ' + tableName + ' (' + name + ')');
                node = xmlDoc.getNextNode(node);
                continue;
            }
            var sysIdText = this._findChildText(node, 'sys_id');
            if (sysIdText) {
                attempted++;
                if (this._deleteRecord(tableName, sysIdText, name)) {
                    succeeded++;
                }
            } else {
                this._logVerbose('Composite child has no sys_id, skipping: ' + tableName + ' (' + name + ')');
            }
            node = xmlDoc.getNextNode(node);
        }

        if (attempted === 0) {
            var emptyMsg = 'Composite wrapper payload had no deletable inner records: ' + name;
            gs.error(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': ' + emptyMsg);
            this._stats.errors++;
            this._stats.errorDetails.push(emptyMsg);
            return false;
        }

        this._logVerbose('Composite purge: ' + succeeded + '/' + attempted + ' inner record(s) deleted for ' + name);
        return succeeded === attempted;
    }

    /**
     * Text content of the first direct child element with the given tag name, or null.
     * Walks children directly so we don't depend on XMLDocument2's read-side XPath context.
     */
    _findChildText(parentNode, childTagName) {
        var iter = parentNode.getChildNodeIterator();
        while (iter.hasNext()) {
            var child = iter.next();
            if (child.getNodeName() === childTagName) {
                return child.getTextContent();
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Delete a record. Tries with workflow enabled first; on failure,
     * retries with workflow disabled to bypass cascade failures.
     * @param {string} table - table name
     * @param {string} sysId - record sys_id
     * @param {string} name - version name for logging
     * @returns {boolean} true if record was deleted or not found, false if both attempts failed
     */
    _deleteRecord(table, sysId, name) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        if (!gr.get(sysId)) {
            this._logVerbose('Record not found for purge (may already be deleted): ' +
                table + '/' + sysId + ' (' + name + ')');
            return true;
        }

        // Try with workflow enabled (allows business rules for schema changes)
        try {
            gr.setWorkflow(true);
            if (gr.deleteRecord()) {
                this._logVerbose('Purged with workflow: ' + table + '/' + sysId);
                return true;
            }
            this._log('deleteRecord() returned false for ' + table + '/' + sysId +
                ' (' + name + '). ' + (gs.getLastErrorMessage() || 'No error details available.') +
                ' Retrying with workflow(false).');
        } catch (e) {
            this._log('Delete with workflow(true) failed for ' + table + '/' + sysId +
                ': ' + e.message + '. Retrying with workflow(false).');
        }

        // Fallback: disable workflow to bypass cascade failures
        var gr2 = new GlideRecord(table);
        if (gr2.get(sysId)) {
            gr2.setWorkflow(false);
            if (!gr2.deleteRecord()) {
                var deleteErrorMsg = 'deleteRecord() failed for ' +
                    table + '/' + sysId + ' (' + name + '). ' + (gs.getLastErrorMessage() || 'No error details available.');
                this._log(deleteErrorMsg);
                this._stats.errors++;
                this._stats.errorDetails.push(deleteErrorMsg);
                return false;
            }
            this._logVerbose('Purged with workflow(false): ' + table + '/' + sysId);
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Parse version name to extract table and sys_id.
     * Format: "table_name_<32-char-hex-sys-id>"
     * @param {string} name - version name
     * @returns {Object|null} { table, sysId } or null
     */
    _extractRecordInfo(name) {
        if (!name) {
            return null;
        }

        var match = name.match(/^(.+)_([0-9a-f]{32})$/);
        if (!match) {
            return null;
        }

        return {
            table: match[1],
            sysId: match[2]
        };
    }

    /**
     * Mark a version as backed out.
     * @param {GlideRecord} versionGr - sys_update_version record
     */
    _markVersionBackedOut(versionGr) {
        versionGr.setWorkflow(false);
        versionGr.setValue('state', BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.STATES.BACKED_OUT);
        versionGr.update();
    }

    /**
     * Delete all sys_update_xml entries for the update set.
     * @param {string} updateSetId - update set sys_id
     */
    _deleteUpdateXmlEntries(updateSetId) {
        if (this._options.dryRun) {
            return;
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_XML);
        gr.addQuery('update_set', updateSetId);
        gr.query();
        gr.deleteMultiple();
        this._log('Deleted sys_update_xml entries for update set: ' + updateSetId);
    }

    /**
     * Delete the update set record.
     * @param {string} updateSetId - update set sys_id
     */
    _deleteUpdateSet(updateSetId) {
        if (this._options.dryRun) {
            return;
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_SET);
        if (gr.get(updateSetId)) {
            gr.deleteRecord();
            this._log('Deleted update set: ' + updateSetId);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Create a temporary workspace update set so revert operations
     * don't pollute the user's current update set.
     */
    _switchToWorkspaceUpdateSet() {
        var gus = new GlideUpdateSet();
        this._originalUpdateSetId = gus.get();

        var gr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_SET);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setValue('name', 'Backout workspace - ' + this._updateSetId);
        gr.setValue('state', 'in progress');
        var tempId = gr.insert();

        if (tempId) {
            gus.set(tempId);
            this._workspaceUpdateSetId = tempId;
            this._logVerbose('Switched to workspace update set: ' + tempId);
        } else {
            gs.warn(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': Failed to create workspace update set. Proceeding without isolation.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Restore the original update set and clean up the workspace.
     * Called in finally block to guarantee cleanup.
     */
    _restoreOriginalUpdateSet() {
        if (this._originalUpdateSetId) {
            var gus = new GlideUpdateSet();
            gus.set(this._originalUpdateSetId);
            this._logVerbose('Restored original update set: ' + this._originalUpdateSetId);
        }

        if (this._workspaceUpdateSetId) {
            try {
                var xmlGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_XML);
                xmlGr.addQuery('update_set', this._workspaceUpdateSetId);
                xmlGr.query();
                xmlGr.deleteMultiple();

                var usGr = new GlideRecord(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.TABLES.UPDATE_SET);
                if (usGr.get(this._workspaceUpdateSetId)) {
                    usGr.deleteRecord();
                }
                this._logVerbose('Cleaned up workspace update set: ' + this._workspaceUpdateSetId);
            } catch (e) {
                gs.warn(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': Failed to clean up workspace update set: ' + e.message);
            }
        }
    }

    _log(message) {
        gs.info(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ': ' + message);
    }

    _logVerbose(message) {
        if (this._options.verbose) {
            gs.info(BuildAgentUpdateSetBackOut.LOG_PREFIX + ' [verbose]: ' + message);
        }
    }
}]]></script>
